messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — elevated 5xx rate (gateway) for inference-gateway-usw2. Error pattern: 502/504 timeouts + 5xx from model-runtime. Alerting teams: eng-runtime, oncall.

sam: seeing ~8% 5xx for inference requests to model v2-quant over the last 6m. Latency also spiking to 8s P95.

maria: confirmed. Dashboards show concurrent OOM kills on runner nodes + segfaults on model-runner. FC logs: 'runtime: panic: invalid memory address' in attention kernel.

sam: starting live capture. running: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/infer-gateway --since=5m` to get gateway traces, and `kubectl -n runtime logs pod/model-runner-*/kernel -c runner --tail=200` for segfaults.

jamie: re-route policy — can we flip traffic to fallback model (v2-fp16) for the customer tier flagged in the alert? That should reduce noisy kernel paths.

alex: I can push reroute. Applying policy now: `redwood route set --service inference-gateway --match model:v2-quant --fallback model:v2-fp16 --percent 100 --reason "pager mitigation"`

incidents-bot: Route change recorded by alex at 3135801251.

maria: collecting core dumps from affected runner pods: `/var/crash/core.*` present on three nodes (runner-5, runner-7, runner-9). Uploading to /s3/incidents/3135801234/ for postmortem.

sam: quick sanity test after reroute — error rate dropped to ~1.2% in the last 90s. P95 latency down to 350ms. Looks like fallback model avoids the quant kernel that was failing.

ops-lead: customer impact note — customers in the Startup and Midmarket tiers may have experienced transient 5xx between 09:47–09:54 UTC. We'll flag impacted requests for retries and issue advisory if SLOs breached.

jamie: can we keep the reroute for 30m while we triage kernel? Also enable verbose tracing on one runner node to replicate locally.

alex: ack. Enabled verbose tracing on runner-7 and bumped the autoscaler to +2 nodes for the runtime pool. Command: `terraform apply -var scale_delta=2` (started).

sre-ops-bot: Autoscaler event: scale up started for pool runtime-usw2 at 3135801268. Estimated ready: ~90s.

maria: trace from runner-7 shows repeated `kv_cache` growth and then an allocation failure, followed by `SIGSEGV` in quant attention path. Suspect regression in quant-kernel v1.3.

sam: assign ticket and hotfix plan — hotpatch candidate: revert quant-kernel to v1.2 on canary nodes, validate, then roll forward. Who's on the hotpatch?

alex: i'll take hotpatch. Steps: 1) Mark canary nodes 2) deploy kernel v1.2 to canary 3) run load test against canary 4) if green, roll. Starting step 1.

incidents-bot: On-call handoff: sam -> jamie at 3135801285 (sam going to follow-up runbook).

ops-lead: Documentation for incident: collect timeline, core dumps, route-change diff, affected customer list. Assigning follow-up to sam and maria. Good mitigation for now. :white_check_mark:
